author: Todd Huffman from Phoenix, AZ
attribution: Photo: Todd Huffman from Phoenix, AZ, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%27tronics_(3841141475).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Bank fascia in Jalalabad, shot through a car window. The Pashto name before 'بانک' is cut off at the right edge. The small Pashto line under the red rule ('د ننگرهار نماینده گی', Nangarhar branch) is not transcribed because ګ vs گ cannot be told apart at this size. 'DIGITECH COMPUTERS' sign at left and election posters are distractors.

author: Tracy Hunter
attribution: Photo: Tracy Hunter, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Welcome_to_Bamyan_Ancient_City_sign_2007.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Be shahr-e bastani-ye Bamiyan khosh amadid (Welcome to the ancient city of Bamiyan)

notes: Hand-painted welcome board at the Bamiyan Buddha site. Only the headings are transcribed. Not transcribed: the Dari paragraph (two lines starting 'دیدارکننده' with one word obscured by a rust stain), the small Dari credit line 'ریاست اطلاعات، فرهنگ و توریزم بامیان' and the English paragraph 'Respected Visitors From Historic and Cultural Collection of Buddha monument Sits. Pleas pay the Charge of V. tickets before visit. Thanks'. In the heading, 'شهرباستانی' is written without a space. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Welcome to Bamyan Ancient City sign 2007.jpg

author: Tracy Hunter
attribution: Photo: Tracy Hunter, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Entry_Sign_in_Bamiyan.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Mojasseme-ye bozorg-e Buda (The large Buddha statue)

notes: Blue UNESCO board at the Large (Salsal) Buddha niche, Bamiyan. Only headings transcribed. The six-line English paragraph ('THIS NATIONAL MONUMENT WITH UNIQUE IMPORTANCE TO HUMANKIND ... DO NOT ENTER !') and the matching seven-line Dari paragraph are not transcribed. Digits are Persian (۵ ۶). 'UNESCO' logo text is between the columns. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Peretz Partensky from San Francisco, USA
attribution: Photo: Peretz Partensky from San Francisco, USA, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2011_shop_sign_Herat_Afghanistan_5452486521.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Mojtama'-e tejarati wa parche-saray (Trade and fabric complex)

notes: Hand-painted shop sign in Herat with a painted veiled figure; '۷۸۶' (Persian digits) is small at top centre. 'سرای' is painted at the top left, ending the first line. Two small bottom lines (importers from Japan, Korea, China, Dubai, Indonesia; wholesale and retail chadari etc.) are partly hidden behind the painted hand and are not transcribed. The 'خیاطی ها کوپیان' banner at right is a distractor.

author: Leonard J. DeFrancisci
attribution: Photo: Leonard J. DeFrancisci, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Camp_Leatherneck_sign_01.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Concrete welcome wall, Helmand. The emblem ring text ('MARINE EXPEDITIONARY BRIGADE', 'TASK FORCE LEATHERNECK', 'RC SOUTH') is not transcribed. The base is now Camp Shorabak on maps.

author: Jim Kelly
attribution: Photo: Jim Kelly, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2009_Herat_Afghanistan_signage_(4072962022).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Adres: Shahr-e Naw - Market-e Hazratha (Address: Shahr-e Naw, Hazratha Market)

notes: Target is the small blue clinic sign on the pole at top left (about 230 px wide), Herat. Its third line (specialities: 'اختصاص بیماری های زنان جراحی ... و سونوگرافی') is too small to read reliably and is not transcribed. The large ACC/USAID project board ('Biodiversity Conservation in Afghanistan by Women') is a distractor, not a place sign. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: peretzp
attribution: Photo: peretzp, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/68877611@N00/5472957181. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue police checkpoint sign in Kabul; 'Ring of steel' is set in an arc. The small Dari line between '15' and 'پولیس' (reads like 'کندک کمربند شهری کابل', Kabul city ring battalion) is not transcribed because one word cannot be read with certainty.
